integrity: Ordinary explicit proof and reproducible finite-field tests; no independent review or universal computer certification.
scientific_limitations: Dependent generating vectors and characteristic two are not treated. Path generators and extremal-generator minimum are known prior results, not newly claimed. Prior equivalence in older extremal literature remains a priority risk.
scope: Finite-dimensional symplectic spaces over arbitrary fields of characteristic different from two; independent nonzero vectors; exact Lie closure under rank-one symplectic transvections and full-basis dimension spectrum.
title: Componentwise quadratic closure of independent symplectic transvections
